Recorded observation is separate from a typed receipt. Cross-business, sign-out, CSRF/origin/cookie errors, extra fields, query aliases, wrong methods and disabled construction are exercised. Authorized original reads survive a recovery write pause.

One shared operation key survives; the losing side returns original_recorded or operation conflict.
